verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant work inside the workspace within limits the user sets. It can list audits and evidence requests and add comments, attachments, and status updates. That is a documented programmatic interface for agents, but the pack shows no general public REST/GraphQL API, API reference, or API-key/auth documentation, so the story is only partly delivered. Missing for 10: documented public REST/GraphQL API reference, authentication/token docs, coverage beyond audits/evidence requests, independent hands-on corroboration.
